name: Ongeku
summary: Uthek sends you from Desolace to find a shard of draenethyst. The earth has whispered of the red crystal to him, and Ongeku holds a shard in the Swamp of Sorrows.

sections.title: A Crystal from Far Away
sections.body:
After Stealing Supplies, Uthek the Wise sends you far from Desolace for a red crystal called draenethyst. He says the earth shares its secrets with those who listen. The crystal has only recently come to this land, carried from a place of flying mountains ruled by demons.

Uthek says a shard will make the magic strong. Ongeku, the lost one, holds one in the Swamp of Sorrows in the Eastern Kingdoms. When you return, Uthek will seek proof that the Gelkis can still call you friend.

faq.answer: Uthek the Wise is a Gelkis centaur at Gelkis Village in Desolace. He says the earth whispers its secrets to those who listen.
Draenethyst is a red crystal that Uthek says has only recently come to this land. He says it comes from a place of flying mountains ruled by demons.
Ongeku is a Lost One who holds a draenethyst shard in the central Swamp of Sorrows in the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Why does Uthek want a draenethyst shard?
faq.answer: Uthek says a draenethyst shard will make the magic strong.
Stealing Supplies came before this. Uthek gave it to you earlier.
